STS2DIFFICULTYONLY-ENEMY_REWORKS.title: Enemy Reworks
STS2DIFFICULTYONLY-ENEMY_REWORKS.descrip: Use MPX enemy moves, targeted intents, powers and rotation mechanics, including the approved encounter cards. Original reworks apply to multiplayer parties. Independent of card, potion and event options; locks at run start.
STS2DIFFICULTYONLY-ENEMY_DAMAGE_COMPENSA: Enemy base attack damage: no bonus for 1–2 players; +10% for 3 players; +25% for 4 players. Round halves away from zero before Strength and other modifiers.
STS2DIFFICULTYONLY-INCREASED_ENEMY_SCALI: For 3 players: 1 + 2 × (ActScaling − 1). For 4 players: 1 + 3 × (ActScaling − 1). Preserve original spawn, hatchling, Test Subject, and Flutter exceptions. Settings lock when the run launches. Host settings govern co-op.
STS2DIFFICULTYONLY-DEATH_MODE.title: Multiplayer Death Mode
STS2DIFFICULTYONLY-DEATH_MODE.descriptio: Host-controlled co-op death behavior. Vanilla leaves normal STS2 death handling in place. Vanilla+ adds Neow's Clutch after revival. Everyone Dies kills the party when one player dies. Stay Dead Until Mended keeps dead players down until rest-site revival, preserving the original boss-room exception. Does not affect solo play.
Enable all MPX vanilla-card multiplayer adaptations, including Decay and multiplayer status changes. Off restores vanilla behavior and card-library text. Co-op only; independent of Enemy Reworks. Host-controlled; locks at run start.
STS2DIFFICULTYONLY-MULTIPLAYER_POTION_CH: Enable ally targeting and recipient card choices for Attack, Skill, Power and Colorless Potions, plus potion-bar reconciliation. Off restores vanilla behavior. Independent of card reworks. Host-controlled; locks at run start.
STS2DIFFICULTYONLY-MULTIPLAYER_EVENTS.de: Allow the five original MPX multiplayer events, with their event-only Immortal and Improvements cards and A Lingering Something relic. Off excludes these events from new event selection; existing saved rewards remain. Co-op only; host-controlled; locks at run start.
